text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock D at a gain felt satisfying, but a profitable sale alone does not show that the timing or decision was sound; I should judge it against my plan.","My account’s swings and recovery do not reveal what prices will do next, so I should not chase recent moves or wait for a rebound based on past prices.","Checking daily can tempt me to act without useful new information; I should review positions against clear goals and risk limits rather than trade just to feel in control."]}
